integrity: The bijection is proved by exact integer algebra, and a standalone standard-library verifier checks the divisor parametrization and 96 small full-equation cases. The source-specific correction is separated from the classical factorization fact.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the square-product coefficient branch \(ab\) square of the even-exponent equation. It does not alter the nonsquare \(t>1\) Pell branch or the paper's odd-exponent method. The factorization of square-discriminant Pell equations is classical; the contribution is the exact reduction and source-specific boundary correction.
title: Square-product coefficients form the finite branch of a recent Pell reduction
